verdict.rationale: Visa documents and ships an official MCP server (Visa Acceptance Agent Toolkit) that lets AI agents connect to Visa Intelligent Commerce APIs, published on npm and GitHub, corroborated by a live runtime probe confirming the package's existence. This is Visa acting as an API/platform vendor exposing MCP as an official integration point, which fits the applicable axis. Missing for 10: deeper independent/hands-on developer reports of using the MCP server in production and more detail on tool coverage beyond invoicing/payment links.
